newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CITIC Pac sees Dragonair listing in 98 at earliest.
newsitem.headline: CITIC Pac sees Dragonair listing in 98 at earliest.

text.p: CITIC Pacific Ltd confirmed on Wednesday that Hong Kong Dragon Airlines (Dragonair) intended to list its shares in 1998 at the earliest.
"But whether it will be done in 1998 will still need to be discussed then," CITIC Pacific managing director Henry Fan said.
A Chinese-language newspaper on Wednesday quoted Fan as saying the carrier's flotation could be arranged in 1998.
CITIC Pacific holds 28 percent of Dragonair.
In October, Fan said the air carrier had decided to delay its listing until the end of 1997 at the earliest.
Fan said on Wednesday there was no new delay with the current view on timing as Dragonair still may list just about one year from now at earliest.
The market had initially expected a listing before the end of 1996, later shifting hopes to the first quarter of 1997.
Fan said in October the plans were delayed because 1996 earnings would not truly reflect the firm's growth.
China National Aviation Corp holds about 36 percent of Dragonair, while Swire Pacific Ltd and Cathay Pacific Ltd together hold about 26 percent.
